messages:
Jordan Kim: hey team, just got my MacBook Air M2 and followed the enrollment link, but Jamf shows 'Awaiting device assignment' and DEP says record not found. FileVault didn't prompt during setup so disk is currently unencrypted. Can someone grant a one-time admin or advise? Need to get dev certs and Docker installed today. /cc @Nina Patel

Nina Patel: welcome Jordan! :wave: bummer. If the DEP/Automated Device Enrollment record wasn't associated with the serial in Jamf, enrollment will fail like that. Quick question: did you accept the 'Remote Management' prompt during OOBE? Also run `About This Mac -> System Report -> Hardware -> Serial Number` and paste the serial so we can confirm in Jamf.

Jordan Kim: I accepted the prompt. Serial is C02JK0XXXXX. Jamf UI for device shows nothing for that serial (search returns no results).

it-ops-bot: [automated] ADE_CHECK failed for serial C02JK0XXXXX - device not found in DEP for org 'Redwood Inc' - logged 2025-07-09T11:04:12Z

Nina Patel: thanks. Looks like the device slipped through the ADE import — possible shipping SKU mismatch. Two paths: (A) ops can add the serial to Jamf and push the enrollment profile remotely (can take ~30m), or (B) we create a temporary local admin (12h) so mac-admin can enroll manually and enable FileVault (we prefer B for faster onboarding). Which do you want?

Jordan Kim: (B) please — need Docker + Homebrew set up today. Happy to screenshare.

mac-admin: I can create a temp admin and join the screen. Jordan, please be ready in ~20m. Plan: 1) create local admin account 'temp-admin-jk' (12h expiry) and DM creds 2) remote in, run `sudo jamf enroll -prompt` (ARM-compatible Jamf binary) 3) run `sudo fdesetup enable -user Jordan -personal` to enable FileVault and escrow the recovery key to Jamf Pro 4) verify in Jamf that MDM profile and FileVault key are present, then remove temp admin. Note: on Apple silicon we may need to disable secure boot lower setting if third-party kernel extensions are required for your VPN/Docker. We'll check before changing anything.

Jordan Kim: thanks — I'll be at my desk and plugged in. I use the corporate GlobalProtect VPN and Docker Desktop (Apple Silicon build).

mac-admin: noted. If Secure Boot needs adjustment we'll do that with you present (requires recovery key and a restart into recovery). Also remind you to sign into your personal iCloud? No need — keep personal iCloud off for corp Macs.

Jordan Kim: understood. Quick Q: how will I get the recovery key?

mac-admin: Jamf will escrow the FileVault recovery key to our Jamf Pro. We'll show you the Device record and confirm the key is present before removing temp admin. Recovery key won't be emailed.

it-ops-bot: [automated] temp-admin account temp-admin-jk created for Jordan Kim - expires 2025-07-09T23:00:00Z

Jordan Kim: got the DM with creds, starting screenshare now. Thanks everyone!

mac-admin: session complete — Jamf enroll succeeded using ARM enrol binary, fdesetup enabled and recovery key escrowed. Verified in Jamf Pro UI. Removed temp-admin-jk account and rotated creds. Jordan, you should log out and back in; FileVault will require a restart to complete the encryption.

Jordan Kim: restart done, FileVault shows encrypting in System Preferences. All good, Docker installed and running. Thanks so much :raised_hands:

Nina Patel: welcome aboard Jordan! tagging infra to update ADE import process and add a check for missing serials in morning runbook. If anything else pops up (VPN kernel extensions), file a ticket and we'll coordinate with mac-admin. :tada:
